'''Revan's Cross of Glory''' was the [[Cross of Glory]] awarded to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] at the end of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Three centuries later, it had ended up in a [[Republic Foundation Museum|museum]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
